charter_guarantees.title: Complete Civil and Criminal Immunity
charter_guarantees.clause: A Good Samaritan shall not be liable for any civil or criminal action for any injury to or death of the victim of an accident involving a motor vehicle, which resulted from the Good Samaritan's negligence in acting or failing to act while rendering emergency medical or non-medical care or assistance.

charter_guarantees.title: Right to Total Anonymity & Voluntary Details
charter_guarantees.clause: A Good Samaritan who respects or transports an injured person shall not be compelled to disclose their name, identity, address or other personal details to police, hospital administration, or law enforcement.

charter_guarantees.title: Mandatory Hospital Admission Without Deposit
charter_guarantees.clause: All government and private hospitals are legally mandated to admit and provide immediate emergency first-aid without demanding advance cash deposit from the rescuer.

charter_guarantees.title: Strict Ban on Police Detention & Coercion
charter_guarantees.clause: Police authorities are strictly forbidden from detaining a Good Samaritan at the police station or scene of accident. Examination as a witness is strictly voluntary and at the choice of the Good Samaritan.
